risk_summary: The disclosure is largely specific and quantitatively detailed, with clear year-over-year comparisons and explanations of acquisitions, currency, margins, and cash flows. Key risks include supplier losses, ERP-related inefficiencies, elevated SG&A following the PF acquisition, acquisition-related leverage, and reliance on expected future cash generation and capital-market access. The tone is cautiously positive on liquidity and strategic prospects but includes material forward-looking assumptions.
